dish.title: Spanish Chorizo and Pepper Rice
dish.description: One-pan Spanish-style rice cooked with sliced cured chorizo, blistered peppers, onion, garlic, smoked paprika, and tomatoes.

recipe_version.title: Spanish Chorizo and Pepper Rice
recipe_version.description: One-pan Spanish-style rice cooked with sliced cured chorizo, blistered peppers, onion, garlic, smoked paprika, and tomatoes.

ingredients.name: Spanish chorizo
ingredients.note: HARD PORK CONTRACT. Dry-cured Spanish-style chorizo (paprika-forward), sliced into 1/4-inch coins. Pork sausage — meat allergen. Not Mexican fresh chorizo crumble. Confirm casing is edible or remove casing before slicing.

ingredients.name: short-grain rice
ingredients.note: uncooked. Spanish-style absorption rice. Rinse until water runs clearer. Not brown rice for this clock.

ingredients.name: red bell pepper
ingredients.preparation: stemmed, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch strips

ingredients.name: green bell pepper
ingredients.preparation: stemmed, seeded, and cut into 1/2-inch strips

ingredients.name: smoked paprika
ingredients.note: sweet or bittersweet smoked paprika. Not cayenne-only chili powder.

ingredients.name: crushed tomatoes
ingredients.note: one 14-oz can. Not tomato paste alone.

ingredients.name: vegetable stock
ingredients.note: low-sodium preferred. HARD: vegetable stock only — keeps poultry out of the pan. Not seafood stock. Not chicken stock.

ingredients.name: olive oil
ingredients.note: for the skillet start; chorizo also renders fat

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: start with 3/4 tsp; finish to taste after stock and chorizo salt

steps.title: Prep the pan ingredients
steps.body: Slice the Spanish chorizo into 1/4-inch coins. Dice the yellow onion. Cut the red and green bell peppers into 1/2-inch strips. Mince the garlic. Rinse the rice until the water runs clearer; drain well. Chop the parsley. Cut the lemon into wedges. Measure the smoked paprika, cumin, crushed tomatoes, stock, olive oil, kosher salt, and black pepper. Confirm the chorizo is cured Spanish-style pork sausage, not Mexican fresh chorizo and not a seafood sausage.

steps.title: Brown the chorizo and blister the peppers
steps.body: Heat the olive oil in a 12-inch deep skillet or wide sauté pan over medium heat. Add the chorizo coins in a single layer. Cook, turning once, until the edges brown and paprika-stained fat renders, about 4 to 5 minutes. Add the onion and both peppers with 1/2 tsp of the kosher salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until the peppers blister at the edges and the onion softens, about 6 to 7 minutes. Do not add shrimp, mussels, or clams.

steps.title: Toast spices and rice
steps.body: Stir in the garlic, smoked paprika, and cumin. Cook until fragrant, about 30 to 45 seconds. Add the rinsed drained rice. Stir to coat every grain in the red fat, about 1 minute. Pour in the crushed tomatoes and stock. Add the remaining 1/2 tsp kosher salt and the black pepper. Stir once to settle the rice in an even layer. Bring to a lively simmer over medium-high heat.

steps.title: Absorb and rest
steps.body: Reduce heat to low. Cover tightly. Cook undisturbed until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed, about 16 to 18 minutes. Remove from heat. Rest covered 5 minutes. Fluff with a fork. Taste; the rice should be seasoned by the chorizo fat, paprika, and tomatoes — add a pinch more salt only if needed. Scatter the parsley. Serve from the pan with lemon wedges. No paella socarrat chase required. No shellfish. kitchen_tested is false.

equipment: 12-inch deep skillet or wide sauté pan with lid
recipe_version.heat: Medium for browning chorizo and peppers; medium-high to bring to simmer; low covered for absorb. No oven. No grill.
recipe_version.doneness: Rice tender and liquid absorbed after covered cook plus 5-minute rest. Peppers blistered at edges. Chorizo browned. No raw crunchy rice. kitchen_tested is false.

curator_preflight.detail: Chorizo browns first; peppers and onion follow; spices toast; rice absorbs with tomatoes and stock. Parsley and lemon finish. All listed ingredients used.
2 tbsp olive oil plus rendered chorizo fat. Fully accounted in step 2.
Sofrito-style base and one-pan arroz built in the skillet. Not a boxed Spanish rice mix. Not paella with seafood.
Prep 12 (slice/dice/rinse) + cook 33 (5 chorizo + 7 peppers + 1 toast + 18 absorb + 5 rest overlapping lid) = 45. Cook clock uses 33 for skillet work including covered absorb and rest.
Use a smaller skillet at 1–2 so rice stays in a shallow layer. Stock-to-rice ratio holds.
